# learn-skills

Personal collection of [Agent Skills](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agent runtimes.

## Skills

| Skill | Description | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`webread`](./skills/webread/SKILL.md) | Save any http(s) URL as clean Markdown via the user's real Chrome. Embedded images downloaded locally. Routes Twitter & Feishu to dedicated CLIs. | `0.5.0` |

## Install

### Claude Code

Install everything to `~/.claude/skills/`:

```bash
npx skills add xpzouying/learn-skills -a claude-code -g -y
```

Install a single skill:

```bash
npx skills add xpzouying/learn-skills -s webread -a claude-code -g -y
```

Or via Plugin Marketplace (inside Claude Code):

```text
/plugin marketplace add xpzouying/learn-skills
/plugin install learn-skills@learn-skills        # full bundle
/plugin install webread@learn-skills             # single skill
```

### Codex / Cursor / other agents

Same command, swap the `-a` flag (the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills) supports 55+ agents):

```bash
npx skills add xpzouying/learn-skills -a codex -g -y
npx skills add xpzouying/learn-skills -a cursor -g -y
```

Drop `-g` to install into the current project's `.claude/skills/` (or equivalent) instead of the global directory.

### Claude Desktop

Download the latest `learn-skills.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/xpzouying/learn-skills/releases), then in Claude Desktop:

1. Settings → Customize → Skills → **Create skill**
2. Upload the ZIP

## Update

```bash
npx skills update -g -y
```

The CLI compares each installed skill's local hash against the remote `git tree` SHA and pulls only what changed.

## Uninstall

```bash
# Remove everything from this collection
npx skills remove xpzouying/learn-skills -g

# Remove a single skill
npx skills remove webread -g
```

For Claude Desktop: open Customize → Skills, find the entry, click `…` → Delete.

## Skill development conventions

If you fork this repo to add your own skills:

- Each skill lives in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`
- `SKILL.md` frontmatter must have `name` (lowercase, kebab-case), `description`, and `metadata.version`
- Optional sibling files (`README.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`) get bundled with the skill
- Bump `metadata.version` in `SKILL.md` and the matching entry in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` together

- [`vercel-labs/agent-skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills) — the `npx skills` CLI that powers installation
- [`tw93/Waza`](https://github.com/tw93/Waza) — repository structure and marketplace.json conventions

# webread (Claude Code skill)

Save any web page as clean, self-contained Markdown — by driving your real Chrome through [kimi-webbridge](https://www.kimi.com/features/webbridge), then converting via the [`webread`](https://github.com/xpzouying/webread) CLI. Embedded images are downloaded locally so the saved article works offline. Login-gated content, JS-rendered SPAs, and Chinese sites (微信公众号, 新浪) all just work. Twitter/X and Feishu URLs route to dedicated CLIs that already produce clean structured output.

## Prerequisites

1. **kimi-webbridge** — Chrome extension + Kimi Desktop App
   Install: [https://www.kimi.com/features/webbridge](https://www.kimi.com/features/webbridge) ([中文](https://www.kimi.com/zh-cn/features/webbridge))
   The daemon runs at `localhost:10086` while the Kimi Desktop App is open.

2. **`webread` CLI** — HTML→Markdown converter (default route)
   ```bash
   npm install -g webread
   ```

3. **(Optional) `librsvg`** — for SVG→PNG conversion in the default route. Without it, SVG images are saved as-is.
   ```bash
   brew install librsvg
   ```

4. **(Optional) `twitter-cli`** — only needed for `twitter.com` / `x.com` URLs. Saves raw tweet JSON. Itself driven by kimi-webbridge, so it inherits your logged-in Chrome session.
   ```bash
   brew tap xpzouying/agent-cli
   brew install twitter-cli
   ```
   Source: [github.com/xpzouying/homebrew-agent-cli](https://github.com/xpzouying/homebrew-agent-cli)

5. **(Optional) `lark-cli`** — only needed for `*.feishu.cn` / `*.larksuite.com` URLs. Saves Feishu doc content via the official CLI.
   ```bash
   npm install -g @larksuite/cli
   ```
   Source: [github.com/larksuite/cli](https://github.com/larksuite/cli)

## Install the skill

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xpzouying/learn-skills.git
ln -s "$(pwd)/learn-skills/webread" ~/.claude/skills/webread
```

Then start a new Claude Code session — skills are discovered at session start.

## Verify

In a fresh Claude Code session, paste any URL:

```
读一下 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/...
```

Claude auto-invokes the skill, saves Markdown to `~/Downloads/webread/<today>/<slug>.md`, and downloads embedded images to a sibling `<slug>-images/` folder (Markdown's image links are rewritten to local relative paths). Claude responds with one line — `Saved to <path>` — without dumping article body into the conversation. Ask "总结一下" / "what does it say?" afterward to have Claude read the saved file.

## What gets saved

```
~/Downloads/webread/2026-05-06/
├── article-name-abc12345.md         # default route — clean Markdown
├── status-2049624600-def67890.json  # twitter route — raw twitter-cli JSON
└── article-name-abc12345-images/    # default route only, when the article has images
    ├── img-1.png
    ├── img-2.jpg
    └── img-3.webp
```

For default-route articles, open the `.md` in Obsidian / VS Code preview / any Markdown viewer — images render from the sibling folder, no internet needed. Twitter `.json` files are LLM-friendly as-is; ask Claude "总结一下" afterwards and it will read the file.

## See also
